title: feat: encoded preview develops on the gpu

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: encoded preview develops on the gpu

description: EncodedSource.renderFrame takes the GPU door for preview renders (no nodes, LUT or rotation; everything else falls back to the CPU oracle, noted in the ritim-trace encoded-path line): the decoded planes go to the develop session's YUV pass, reduced first by the tier. Three costs found and removed on the Mi-Log 4K60 and 8K30 clips: (1) the per-pixel Kotlin repack to NV12 (toGpuFrame hands the luma plane over in place and rebuilds CbCr with one bulk copy); (2) the adapter's plane copies now come from PlaneBufferPool, and frames before the seek target are dequeued without any pixel copy; (3) a forward jump inside the current GOP no longer re-seeks to the keyframe and re-decodes the GOP (15-52 decoded frames per render). Playback, device, debug, 12-14 s, tier 720: Mi-Log 4K60 shown 31 -> 98, frame gap p50 408 -> 135 ms, p95 777 -> 230 ms; 8K30 shown 51 -> 148, gap p50 259 -> 82 ms, p95 451 -
